chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Ali ibn Ismail, from Ibn Muskan, from Muhammad ibn Muslim or al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'Do not seek the slips/falls of the believers, for whoever pursues the slips of his brother, Allah will pursue his slips, and whoever Allah pursues his slips, He will expose him, even if he is inside his house.'

key_terms.جَوْفِ بَيْتِهِ: inside the interior of his house (privacy)
key_terms.يَفْضَحْهُ: He will expose him (publicly or privately)

ai.seo_question: What is the consequence of seeking the faults of other believers according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi emphasizes the virtue of 'satr' (concealing faults) in Shia ethics, warning that actively hunting for minor errors leads to divine exposure, even in one's private sphere. It underscores the spiritual danger of 'tatabbu' al-'atharat' (pursuing slips), linking social courtesy with personal accountability before Allah. The narration serves as a practical guide for maintaining communal harmony by avoiding nitpicking among believers.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Ali Bin Ismail, from Ibn Muskan, from Muhammad Bin Muslim, from Al Halby, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Rasool-Allahsaww said: ‘Do not seek the slips of the Momineen, for the one who pursues the slips of his brother, Allahazwj would Pursue his slips, and the one whose slips Allahazwj Pursues, he would be shamed and even though he be inside his house’.
en.sarwar: 5. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Ali ibn Isma’il from ibn Muskan from Muhammad ibn Muslim or al-Halabi from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following:

“The Messenger of Allah has said, ‘Do not seek to find faults with the believers; if one seeks to find fault with his brother (in belief), Allah will find faults with him and whoever’s fault Allah will seek to find. He will bring disgrace upon him and it may take place even inside his very own home.’”
